content: Hessafe guye Dawiti shaalaqatara, mato halaqataranne olanchcha halaqata ubbatara zorettides.

Histtidi Isra7eele asaa ubbaas, «Inttes lo7o misatizayssa gidikkonne GODAA nu Xoossaa shene gidikko Isra7eele biittan mataninne haakon diza nu ishati qasseka bantta katamataninne bantta mehe heemmizasohotan diza qeesetinne Leweti nunara issife shiiqana mala ane kiita yeddoos.
Sa7oole kawoteththa wode nuni yeggi aggida nu Xoossa Taabotaa ane zaaridi ehoos» gides.
Dawiti yootidayssi ammanththizaaz gidida gishshas asay iza qofaa ekkides.
Hessa gishshas Dawiti Xoossaa Taabotaa Qiriyaate-Yi7aarimeppe ehana mala Gibxe zawappe doommidi Hamaate purde gakkanaas diza Isra7eele asaa ubbaa shiishshides.
Dawitinne Isra7eele asay ubbay kirubetappe giddon ba araata bolla uttida GODAA sunththan xeygettida Xoossa Taabotaa ehanaas Yuhuda biittan diza Ba7aala geetettiza Qiriyaate-Yi7aarime katama bida.
Xoossa Taabotaza Abinadaabe sooppe ooraththa para-gaare bolla woththi ehida; para-gaareza laaggizayti Oozanne Ahiyo.
Dawitinne Isra7eele asay ubbay diiththan maasinqon, karaben, daalaninne xurumban bantta kumeththa wolqqan Xoossa sinththan ufayettidi bonchchida.
Istti Kiidoona geetettizason diza kaththa balezakko gakkida wode caanida boorati bargagi dhuphettiin Oozay Taabotaza ashshanaas kushe yeddides.
Iza kushey Taabotaza bochchida gishshas GODAA hanqoy Ooza bolla eexxi kezides; hessa gishshas izi heen GODAA sinththan hayqqides.
GODAY hanqettidi Ooza wodhida gishshas Dawiti kayottides; hach gakkanaas he sohoy Ooza meqoso geetettees.
He gallas Dawiti Xoossas yayyida gishshas, «Xoossa Taabotaa taakko wostta ehanaas dandayazinaa?» gides.
Hessa gishshas Dawiti Taabotaza banara efanaappe Geete dere as Abidaareso efides.
Xoossa Taabotay Abidaareson izaso asatara heedzdzu agina gam7ides; GODAY iza keeththa asaanne izas diza miish ubbaa anjjides.
